labels.lesson.title: Keep the Discussion Moving When It Gets Stuck
labels.section.title: Invite a Contribution Without Pressure
labels.invitation.purpose: Make space for a relevant view
labels.proposal.maya: We could start in pairs and exchange names and interests.
labels.proposal.noah: We could each draw or write one thing we'd like to try, then use that to introduce ourselves.
labels.prompt.exact: A community centre wants a 20-minute welcome activity for new members. Help them meet one another and find out about its weekly drawing group. Your group should recommend one activity and explain how it serves both aims. Use the main room and existing paper and pens; do not buy anything.
labels.goal.group: Find out about the weekly drawing group
labels.invitation.focus: Ask about the task, not the silence
labels.invitation.choice: Contribute, pass, or come in later
labels.model.invitation: A focused invitation with room to pass
labels.pass.response: Accept the pass; return to the task
labels.contrast.open: What would you add or question?
labels.participation.space: Leave room for a later contribution
labels.participation.limit: Do not repeat pressure after a pass
labels.reflection.reset: Return to the moment before the invitation
labels.reflection.prompt: Invite a relevant view; allow passing
labels.recap: Offer an opening; leave the choice real
